chunks: He said: Present him to me.

key_terms.عَلَيْكَ: Present him to me / Bring him to me (imperative form used in commands)

ai.seo_question: What did Ali (peace be upon him) say when he wanted someone to be brought before him?
ai.summary: In this brief yet significant utterance from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (AS) commands 'Bring him to me,' reflecting his characteristic directness and accessibility in judicial or administrative matters. This phrase often precedes a specific ruling or dialogue, highlighting the Imam's role as a judge who engages personally with his companions, underscoring the Shia emphasis on the leader's proximity to the people and immediate responsiveness to their affairs.
